QuestInfo.0: You brought the #t4033427# items to #p3001004#, but there seems to be a problem. Talk to #b#p3001004##k.
QuestInfo.1: According to #p3001004#, extracting minerals from the #t4033427# is no easy task. Go see #b#p9031002##k in #bArdentmill#k.
QuestInfo.2: You delivered the minerals to #p3001004#. Hopefully it's enough.

0.0: You must be wondering why I would need a supply of #t4033427# to break a seal...
0.1: It turns out they contain a special mineral that can only be found in select regions across Grandis. It's surprisingly strong despite its light weight.
0.2: Given our current circumstances, #m400000000# and HQ cannot provide a steady supply. We've had to resort to stealing tools from Specter Engineers just to mine.
0.3: Unfortunately, as useful as the Grandis Shadow is at providing ore, we are not at our best when it comes time to refining it. That is why I would like you to follow up on a lead I found. There is supposedly a #bCrafting Town called Ardentmill#k in Maple World that is known as a hub of mercantilism. I don't have much more information, but there is a man named #b#p9031002##k you should track down.

yes.0: Take the complete supply of #t4033427# with you.

no.0: I don't know what we're going to do with all these #t4033427# items then...

1.0: The shipment of refined minerals arrived just before you. We're back in business.
1.1: You are ever-vigilant, aren't you? I have another request from #b#p3001000##k, if you're interested.
